current_point.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的时序图表示学习方法，通过将动态时序图建模为快照序列并结合图自编码器与循环神经网络，在四个真实世界大规模图数据集上实现平均内存消耗仅为传统图神经网络算法的9.86%、平均训练时长仅为13.27%，且与性能最优算法在大部分指标上的差距不超过3.5%。
current_point.claim_en: Propose a sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization, which models dynamic sequential graphs as snapshot sequences and combines a graph autoencoder with a recurrent neural network, achieving average memory consumption of only 9.86% and average training time of only 13.27% compared to traditional graph neural network algorithms on four real-world large-scale graph datasets, with performance gaps not exceeding 3.5% on most metrics against the best-performing algorithm.
technical_features: 在四个真实世界的大规模图数据集上进行实验验证
平均内存消耗仅为传统图神经网络算法的9.86%
平均训练时长仅为传统图神经网络算法的13.27%
与性能最好的算法在大部分指标下的差距不超过3.5%
technical_features_en: Conduct experiments on four real-world large-scale graph datasets
Average memory consumption is only 9.86% of traditional graph neural network algorithms
Average training time is only 13.27% of traditional graph neural network algorithms
The gap with the best-performing algorithm on most metrics does not exceed 3.5%

current_task.description: Insufficient final evidence for NP-3. This round searches for English literature to substantiate the claimed experimental performance metrics (average memory consumption 9.86%, training time 13.27%, and performance gap within 3.5% on most metrics compared with the best-performing algorithm) of graph-summarization-based temporal graph representation learning approaches on large-scale datasets.
